snippet.title: Last Epoch Season 4 - Shattered Omens - March 26th | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 4 - Shattered Omens launches on March 26th at 11am CST! 

Step into Omen Windows and confront the entities born from the Observer’s madness. Embrace the power of Corruption to transform your gear into powerful new items and reshape your build with Idol Altars which change the shape of your idol inventory. Wield two new Rogue skills as you push deeper into the monolith and discover new Echo Chains. Experience new quality of life updates… and more! 

Be sure to watch out for more updates regarding Season 4 Twitch Drops, New Supporter Packs, and our fantastic week of forums posts starting March 16th!

Link to game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/899770?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=Season4&utm_medium=ytdescription

About Last Epoch
Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.
